meta.title: Pebble & Bean
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/README.md and source/palette.txt: the house style fixes the 16 colours, the isometric 2:1 diorama and the sign style; the README's 'cosy building game' sets the pace and the build-up motion.

source.notes: opening announcement: date, address, menu, how it feels, house style

rationale.palette: The shop's 16 pastels (palette.txt), never black: shadows are darker tiles of the same family. At dusk the whole palette swaps to its evening ramp step by step and the windows glow (glow #FFE8A3).
rationale.type: A 5x7 pixel face with the house sign's one-pixel caramel shadow (modules/bean.js).
rationale.motion: A cosy building game: the shop assembles tile by tile in a diagonal wave, people and the roaster animate in two-frame loops on an 8-fps step clock (86 BPM: about 5.6 steps per beat), steam rises in single pixels.
rationale.sound: Slow lo-fi with game-console sounds (README): 86 BPM in F major, a soft pad, pulse-wave comping, a stepped triangle bass, boom-bap drums with swing and tape.
rationale.visuals: An isometric diorama on a 320 x 180 grid at 6x: the lot builds itself, the cutaway interior with the roaster and the counter, the street at dusk, the opening card.
